verdict.rationale: Base44 has a dedicated first-party docs page for connecting your own custom domain to an app. It also states that SSL certificates are issued and renewed automatically once the domain is connected, which covers the core of the story. Missing for 10: documented DNS or connection steps and any plan or tier requirements in the evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the domain-connection flow.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect a custom domain to my published app

citations.quote: Connect your own custom domain to make your app easier to find, remember, and share.
Base44 issues and renews your SSL certificate automatically once your domain is connected, so your app is always served securely over HTTPS.
